scope: Europe, the Caucasus, Latin America, the Caribbean, Canada (no sub-Saharan Africa; North Africa in stream 1)
note: Units: metres. Kit ids refer to research/sky_islands/architecture/components.json (shared); 'unique' ids are new pieces proposed for the shared library. 'params' are the knobs that make common pieces read as this civilization.

families.name: Tyrrhenian canyon towns
families.mark: 10:1 canyon lanes, bassi at street level, laundry and shrines, tuff and pastel facades

walls.weathering: heavy: damp bands 0-1.5 m, flaking render, streaks

families.mass: perimeter blocks round small courtyards with a portone; lanes are the void
families.openings: french windows 1.1x2.6 with shallow iron balconies on every opening; green louvred shutters; glazed basso doors
families.roofs: flat lastrico terraces with parapets; slate hips (Genoa)

cyberpunk.night: dim warm canyon floor (#ffb35c), neon sky slot above, shrine hot spots

families.name: Rupestrian terraces
families.mark: rock-cut vault cells in an inverted amphitheatre; roofs are the streets; vault humps and pergolas

walls.material: calcarenite blocks / rubble with crushed-stone render
walls.weathering: lichen and soot at cave mouths

families.mass: contour rows of vault cells cut into the slope; each row's roof = the lane above; vicinato courts of 4-8 dwellings round a cistern
growth: cyberpunk capsule vaults in new cuts
families.openings: deep arched doors 1.0x2.2 with lunette; small square windows; reveals >= 0.5
families.roofs: exposed barrel/cross vault humps, whitewashed; flat parts with vine pergolas
families.water: rock-cut cisterns and runnels, pond at the foot

additions: composite capsule pods socketed into rock
cyberpunk.night: starfield of small warm windows (#ffcf7a) over the slope, cool LED stair rails (#7fd8ff), glowing cave mouths

families.name: Cycladic islands
families.mark: rounded whitewashed cubes in a deliberate maze; cave-houses in the rim; chapel domes; slate paving with white joints
families.mass: wall-to-wall cube clusters of 6-20; external stairs to roof terraces; rim yposkafa vault rows; a chapel per 20-40 houses

streets.lanes: 1.5-2.5 m, a bend every 15-25 m, dead ends

families.openings: small deep windows 0.6x0.9 painted frames; painted doors; timber balconies on corbels
families.roofs: flat with rounded lip or barrel vaults; chapel domes r 1.5-3; bell gables

additions: white composite pods with rounded windows
cyberpunk.night: white walls take on neon; tiny warm windows; blue edge glow; dome uplights; wall lamps every 15 m (#ffd6a0)

families.name: Knights' harbour cities
families.mark: honey limestone grid with stair-streets and stacked coloured gallarija balconies; a polished stone main street
families.mass: continuous terraced frontages on a strict grid; blocks 18-22 m deep round light wells; bastion rim

streets.main: polished limestone 10-12 m on the ridge (mirror-like)

growth: 18-19th c gallarija on every upper storey
families.openings: gallarija 1.0-1.4 deep, 2.5-5 wide, stacked, corner-wrapping; arched shop fanlights; green shutters
families.roofs: flat stone roofs with low parapets (Valletta); red Roman-tile hips (Dubrovnik)

cyberpunk.night: amber-uplit stone (#ffb062), balconies as coloured lanterns, mirror-polished main street (roughness 0.15)

families.name: Lusitanian hill towns
families.mark: azulejo-tiled narrow tall houses on a steep Moorish maze; iron balconies; miradouros; calçada mosaics; trams

walls.weathering: missing tile patches, damp bases, rust streaks

families.mass: tight terraces of tall narrow houses stepping a storey down every 1-2 plots along contours

streets.squares: largo at tram bends, miradouro at ridge turns

families.openings: tall windows 0.9x2.2 with iron cage balconies 0.3-0.6; arched shop doors
families.roofs: tile 20-25 deg, aguas-furtadas attics, chimney pots

cyberpunk.night: glazed tiles reflect neon (gloss 0.25), mosaics under warm lanterns (#ffd08a), outlined miradouros

families.name: Iberian white towns
families.mark: blank whitewashed street walls with box rejas and blue pots; inward flower patios; cobertizos; Mudéjar brick towers; hanging houses
families.mass: introverted courtyard houses in irregular blocks; zaguan to patio; cantilevered timber rooms on cliff rim

streets.lanes: 2-3.5 m, a bend every 10-20 m, ramps

families.openings: box rejas 0.8x1.4 projecting 0.3 with pot shelf; studded doors; miradors; horseshoe arches in patios
families.roofs: Roman tile 15-20 deg; azoteas; hooded chimneys
public_spaces: plaza mayor arcaded 30x40 with fountain and orange trees
families.water: patio fountains/pools, aljibes, plaza pond, acequia rills

cyberpunk.night: white walls blue-grey, warm pools at rejas (#ffcf86), glowing patios via zaguan, lanterns in orange trees

families.name: Ottoman timber towns
families.mark: stone ground floor, timber upper storeys jettied on angled brackets with cumba oriels; ranks of windows; 'upside-down wedding cake'

walls.material: rubble ground; himis timber frame w/ plaster or clapboard above

families.mass: houses on sloping plots with walled back gardens; upper floors square off crooked plots; window rows wrap corners

streets.main: carsi bazaar 5-7 m part-roofed, shop cells 3x4
streets.lanes: 2.5-4 m cobbled, overhangs close sky to 1 m
streets.squares: mosque/church square with plane tree + fountain

families.openings: ranks of timber sashes 0.7x1.6 (4-8/facade); kafes lattice; 3-sided cumba oriel; door in courtyard wall
families.roofs: low hips 25 deg, eaves 1.0-1.5 with soffits; tile or stone slab

cyberpunk.night: rows of warm windows wrapping corners (#ffc46b), patterned light through kafes, uplit brackets make floating bands

families.name: Upper Mesopotamian stone terraces
families.mark: honey limestone cascade, every roof a terrace for the house above; carved south facades; abbara tunnels under houses
families.mass: avlu courtyard houses with upper eyvan, terraced in contour rows; abbaras link rows

streets.abbara: vaulted tunnels 2.5-3 w x 3-4 h, 10-30 long

families.openings: pointed/segmental arches in carved frames with grilles; triple-arched south loggias; carved portals with stone benches
families.roofs: flat terraces with carved balustrades; ribbed domes; square carved minarets
families.water: cisterns, madrasa pools with rills, terrace pond

cyberpunk.night: honey cascade under warm flood (#ffbf6b), raking light on carving, glowing abbara tunnels

families.name: Balkan stone tower-houses
families.mark: fortress-base grey kulla with corbelled window-band top storey under heavy stone-slab roofs

walls.material: limestone rubble, thinning upward; plastered timber top

families.mass: detached near-cube towers on terraced plots along switchbacks; courtyard walls with gates; castle on the ridge

streets.main: bazaar 5-6 m cobbled with white-stone patterns

growth: ottoman mansions w/ corbelled tops + painted rooms
families.openings: base arrow slits 0.3x0.6, studded door; top continuous window band 50%; machicolation box
families.roofs: steep hips 30-35 deg of slab mosaic; deep timber eaves; stone chimney stacks
families.water: stone fountains, castle cisterns, pond below the bridge

additions: PV slates in the slab mosaic
cyberpunk.night: dark bases with glowing top window bands (#ffc777); citadel floodlit white

families.name: Caucasian balcony towns
families.mark: full-width carved timber and stained-glass balconies stacked over cliffs and courtyards; bath domes; Svan towers on the skyline

walls.material: thin Persian brick (limewashed), rubble, stucco; timber balconies
walls.weathering: sagging balconies, lean 1-3 deg, flaking paint

families.mass: perimeter houses round 'Italian courtyards' ringed by 2-3 levels of galleries with spiral stairs; houses on posts over cliffs; Svan tower clusters on upper terraces

streets.squares: bath square, church yards, fortress terrace

growth: 19th c courtyard tenements w/ carved balconies + art nouveau
families.openings: fretwork balconies with turned balusters and carved pelmets; shushabandi small-pane stained-glass galleries; tall double doors
families.roofs: low tin 15-20 deg (red/grey); flat brick with bath domes; slate gables on towers
families.water: river gorge + waterfall (pond with fall), sulphur pools

foliage.place: balconies, courtyard pergolas, wires across lanes

cyberpunk.night: jewel-coloured glowing balconies, warm courtyard wells, lit gorge bridges, glowing bath domes, red aviation lamps on towers (#ff3030)

families.name: Hanseatic gable towns
families.mark: row of narrow tall gabled merchant houses with hoist beams, each gable type and colour different, reflected in canals
families.mass: rows of narrow full-depth houses with back hof yards; warehouse attics with hatch columns; Bryggen timber rows facing plank passages

streets.main: canal quays 6-8 m each side with trees

families.openings: large small-paned windows 60%; attic luiken hatch column + hoist beam; raised stoep doors
families.roofs: steep 50-60 deg pantile/slate behind gables; dormers; verdigris spires
public_spaces: market square 40x60 with town hall spire
families.water: canals every 120-200 m as long ponds; harbour basin

cyberpunk.night: big warm windows doubled in canals, bulb-lit bridge arches (#ffd08a), coloured gable outlines, canal fog

families.name: Scots lands and closes
families.mark: ridge spine street with fishbone closes dropping through pends between 6-12 storey soot-dark rubble lands; crowsteps and many-pot chimneys

walls.material: harled rubble / sooted sandstone with ashlar margins

families.mass: continuous slabs on the spine; tall narrow ranges down each close; turnpike stair towers; small close courts

streets.closes: 1-2.5 m every 10-20 m through pends 2-3 w x 3 h, descending in steps

families.openings: small regular sashes 0.9x1.6; arched pends; timber galleries; shopfront signboards
families.roofs: steep slate 45-55 deg, crowstepped gables, many-pot chimney stacks, dormers, conical turrets
public_spaces: spine street with mercat cross + crown-spire cathedral
loch garden park at the foot

cyberpunk.night: dark slabs with scattered warm sashes (#ffcf86), wet setts reflecting sodium lamps, closes as coloured lit tunnels into fog

families.name: Andean layered towns
families.mark: Inca polygonal stone base, white colonial storeys with box balconies, raw-brick self-built stacks, and neon mirror-glass cholets with a chalet on top
families.mass: colonial casonas with arcaded patios on Inca bases; slope stacks of brick boxes with rebar; cholet towers (shops / ballroom / flats / roof chalet)
families.openings: trapezoid Inca doors/niches; Lima box balconies 1.0 deep latticed; mirror-glass bands with zigzag frames
families.roofs: red tile 25-30 deg wide eaves; flat brick with rebar; cholet chalet crown
public_spaces: plaza de armas 60x80 arcaded with fountain
families.water: inca stone channels + paccha fountains, plaza fountain, terrace pond

additions: cholet LED Andean geometry + ballroom light shows
cyberpunk.night: pulsing cholet colour (#ff2fa0, #30e0d0), amber colonial lanterns, slope sea of small warm windows under cable-car light lines

params.self_built: irregular boxes, brick tone per storey, rebar on top

families.name: Latin hillside self-built cities
families.mark: endless stepping self-built boxes (laje slab terraces with water tanks) or painted corrugated-tin houses, stair alleys, murals, public escalators and cable cars

valparaiso.material: timber frame + corrugated iron (vertical ribs, 0.05 pitch)

walls.weathering: rust streaks, half-painted walls, exposed rebar

families.mass: edge-to-edge offset boxes stepping up the slope; every roof a laje terrace with tank, laundry, stair; palafitos on stilts over ravines
growth: hill, fort/chapel crest, 19th c port town at foot
state upgrades: escalators, library parks, cable cars
families.openings: mismatched aluminium/timber windows, iron grades on everything, roller-shuttered corner shops; Valparaiso bay windows
families.roofs: flat laje with rebar stubs and round blue fibreglass tanks (#2a6ab0); fibre-cement sheets; shallow tin gables
public_spaces: concrete football courts cut into the hill
families.water: blue roof tanks, stair channels, library-park pond

cyberpunk.night: dense field of mismatched tiny lights (#e8f4ff, #ffcf7a, TV blue), zigzag stair-rail LEDs, cable-car necklace

families.name: Creole colonial port cities
families.mark: candy-pastel thick-walled courtyard houses with arcades, stained-glass medio puntos and bougainvillea balconies; palm-and-flame-tree plazas; ravine variant with tunnel streets

walls.weathering: tropical: layered peeling colours, black mould, ferns in cornices, collapsed upper floors

families.mass: grid blocks of contiguous courtyard houses (two-level arcaded patio, fountain, zaguan carriage entry); ravine variant terraced with callejones and tunnel roads
growth: 18th c baroque palaces with portales + medio puntos
families.openings: floor-to-ceiling windows 1.2x3.5 with barrotes/iron + louvres; medio punto lunettes r 0.6-0.9; long covered timber balconies; carriage doors with inset doors
families.roofs: flat azoteas with parapets and urns; tile; dutch clock gables (Willemstad); bell towers, domes
public_spaces: plaza mayor 100x70 with royal palms, flame trees, fountain, kiosco, arcades
families.water: plaza + patio fountains and cisterns, bay as pond, malecon edge pool

additions: neon signs and screens in portales
cyberpunk.night: deep pastels under sodium (#ffb060), jewel-glowing fanlights, bulb strings in plaza palms, coloured spill from portal bars

families.name: Nouvelle-France winter towns
families.mark: steep snow-shedding tin roofs with dormer rows over grey rubble; brick plex rows each wearing a twisting outdoor iron stair; snow on every ledge

walls.weathering: salt base stains, winter grime, permanent snow caps

families.mass: lower-town stone terraces under a cliff, upper town walled on top; plex rows of 7.5 m units with 2-3 front doors each; back ruelles with sheds and tangled galleries
families.openings: small casements 0.9x1.5 many-paned with shutters; dormer rows 2-4 per roof; plex paired tall windows, oriels, stacked doors at each landing
families.roofs: quebec 50-60 deg tin/shingle gables with dormers and gable-end firewall chimneys on corbels; plex flat with pressed-metal bracket cornices
families.water: river quay at foot, frozen park pond

cyberpunk.night: warm windows in steep roofs, snow reflecting (#ffd8a0), iron stair silhouettes, white bulb strings on the boardwalk, magenta ruelles

params.colours: sober stone/brick, coloured doors and stairs
